data.notes: It got the header right and named the real reason, the weekend prototype by the customer's engineer. It also caught that the rep's 'clean one' claim is contradicted by the PayPal/Venmo and saved-card gaps, labeled the Braintree theory as the AE's guess, and reported the approval-rate silence and the customer's own language. It missed the CFO's single question about when sitters get paid as the finance messaging signal, which only shows up indirectly as 'getting sitters paid'.
